root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The sfnt resource-list offset in resourcesZ must remain the original nonzero offset instead of being neutered to zero when resource-record-list sanitization fails.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before HarfBuzz accepts the dfont resource map, OT::ResourceTypeRecord::sanitize() must reject the malformed sfnt resource-record list rather than rewriting resourcesZ from the original nonzero list offset to the null-pool offset 0.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original executes the sfnt resource-list sanitize step with resource_list_offset_before=243 and resource_list_offset_after=0, violating the root obligation at the resourcesZ sanitize site. The fixed original executes the same source event with resource_list_offset_before=243 and resource_list_offset_after=243, preserving the original list offset and preventing the later null-pool fake-face path.

nodes.state: At the IntType::cmp() sink, the compared argument a copied from arr[mid].tag is read as a 4-byte tag while its initialized-prefix length is 0 bytes on the crashing vulnerable execution, so the sink comparison consumes uninitialized tag data.

edges.relation: After the vulnerable sanitize step neuters resourcesZ to zero, the resulting null-pool resource-list pointer is the same ResourceRecord storage later selected to materialize the fake face.
The fake face materialized from the null-pool ResourceRecord reports table_count=86, and that same bogus count is later trusted as the bsearch search_table_count.
The arr[mid].tag storage selected by the vulnerable bsearch probe is the same tag storage later reported as the source of the a operand consumed at the IntType::cmp() sink.
